parts.note_add: On the 1982 car the intermittent (INT) wiper timer is not a separate box: S-001 section D p18 draws it inside the Control Processing Unit (PT301, connector X-16), and the 1985 manual calls it the intermittent wiper relay (in the CPU); its terminals are recorded on PT301 (A, B, F, H, J, L). Confirm whether any separate unit exists on the car.

Factory circuit has no relay: the switch carries the whole grid current from the 15 A fuse (Y in, LG out); the 3.4 W indicator is a separate lamp in the combination meter on the LG line (S-001 p24). New B001-66-460 is NLA at Atkins Rotary; used only.

Grid G-25: LG feed from the switch, B return through D-07 (or X-18 without rear wiper) to ground X-15 (S-001 p24). Test: about 6 V at the centre of each filament with the switch on; repair broken lines with silver paint 2835-77-600.

One box doing the turn/hazard flasher, intermittent wiper relay, lights-on/key reminder chime oscillator, ignition key light timer, buzzer and seat belt timer (S-006 p24, S-001 sections D, F, H); 17-way connector X-16 plus a 1-way GB (S-001 p30). Known failure: cracked solder joints at the board connector, fixed by resoldering (rx7club).

Atkins Rotary lists FA02-67-577 as fitting all 1981-85 RX-7s (out of stock, $199), while the catalogue gives it only to '81 serials up to 503735 and no number for later cars; read the number off the relay - confirm.

The warning oscillator C-10: it takes the oil-level (YR) and coolant-level (YB) warning lines and drives the chime (G), fed via LR from the choke and check relay (S-001 p16). Sits on the left front fender near the battery; when it fails or gets damp the buzzer sounds and will not stop (Atkins Rotary).

Carries the horn relay coil ground (GL via column connector E-01) to the steering shaft; the relay does the horn current, so the contact only carries coil current (S-001 p22). Horn ground runs through the column shaft and a strap across the collapsible joint (rx7club).
A float switch in the reservoir cap: closes BR to B (ground X-13) at low level and lights the 1.4 W BRAKE warning lamp, the same lamp the parking brake switch lights (S-001 p16).
